title: About C.Zara Enterprise
paragraph_1: C.Zara Enterprise is a natural foods business based in Kurudu, FCT, Abuja. It was started in 2021 by Florence Chioma, who most customers know as Floxxy.
paragraph_2: We serve households and businesses in Abuja and beyond with natural honey, nuts, palm oil, foodstuffs and gift selections.
paragraph_3: Every order is handled personally. Message or call Florence and she will confirm what is available, today's price and delivery.
